note: The dividend-eligible register-lot count is fixed from the register's own question — among the students who attended the 'Women's Soccer' event, the count of DISTINCT members who want a medium-size T-shirt.

The benchmark rate index is taken from its book's own question — the average monthly 2013 consumption of SME-segment customers, reported exactly as the book computes it (keep the decimal) — and set the distribution uplift at 1000 per index-unit on the ROUNDED rate index.

The quarter's two independent side-anchor readings for the quarterly overview at the close of the run, each answered exactly as the licensed reference book it reads asks it and each recorded as next quarter's comparison point at the close-out sign-off rather than as an input anything later in this quarter's run reads — the free rate for ages 5-17 at the school run by Kacey Gibson, and how many drivers finished the race on 2015/11/29.
The base dividend is set as that lot count times the declared per-lot dividend of 1000.
The total distribution is the base plus the uplift; the escalation delta equals the uplift.
The distribution branch is decided on the delta — 'SPECIAL_REVIEW' when the delta is at least 100000000, 'REGISTRAR_ESCALATION' when it is at least 100000, 'STANDARD_PAYOUT' otherwise

The distribution review is booked conflict-free on business days: a 30-minute event in afternoon hours (13:00-17:00), at the earliest weekday slot at/after the review window's end that does not overlap any of your other events.
